delta.description: With skill: 18/18 assertions passed (100%). Baseline: 17/18 passed (94.4%). The skill caught the TTL expiresAt violation that the baseline missed.

analyst_observations: The one discriminating finding: Eval 1 TTL assertion — with_skill correctly traced the bug to url.ts:48-54 (transform always sets expiresAt). Baseline read the wrong line (url.ts:152, the response formatter) and falsely marked it COMPLIANT.
Eval 2 and Eval 3: both with_skill and without_skill performed equally well — the task is well-defined enough that an unguided agent can also find violations when explicitly asked.
The skill's structured 6-dimension framework prevents coverage gaps. Without it, the baseline might reorganize dimensions differently each run.
The skill adds ~6k tokens overhead per run (avg 88k vs 82k). This is small relative to the benefit of systematic coverage.
Future improvement: add assertions that check whether the Priority Fix List is correctly ordered by severity — a subtle signal the skill handles but baseline might not.
